pretreatments.description: Dewatering of sludge using a belt filter press to a water content of approximately 80%.
Low-temperature thermal pretreatment at temperatures between 50 °C and 80 °C for durations that varied from 15 to 90 min.
Rapid cooling of thermally treated sludge to 33 °C immediately after thermal treatment.
Batch anaerobic digestion of the thermally treated sludge in bottles with shaking and temperature control (35 ± 2 °C).
Semi-continuous HSAD in a pilot-scale digester with intermittent stirring (3 h stirring and 3 h off) and temperature control (35 ± 2 °C).
Measurement of physical and chemical parameters (TS, VS, total alkalinity, total nitrogen, total ammonia nitrogen, COD, and total phosphorus) of the sludge samples.
Evaluation of the release of COD, VFAs, and nitrogen during thermal treatment.
Analysis of sludge viscosity using a rate-controlled viscometer at various shear rates.
